d: A room covered with damask with family portraits and kind arms, decorated in the style of the 18th century, but in a bad state. In front of two windows: the one on the left closed, the other on the right open and practicable, from which you see a very pure sky, illuminated by the moon, and peaks of trees. Among the windows is a large closed closet, containing clothes, whitewashers, etc., etc.Each of the side walls has two doors. The first on the right of the viewer is the municipality; the second puts to the room of Curra. To the left is the apartment of the Marquis, more near the proscenium than Leonora. At half scene, quite to the left, is a table covered with damask carpet, and above the same one guitar, flower vases, two silver candleslabres lit with lampshadows, only light that will light up the room. A high chair at the table; a cabinet with an oriuluo between the two doors on the right; another piece of furniture, which is the picture above, the whole wall.
Curra follows the Marquis, closes the door on the way out, and returns to Leonora, abandoned on the high chair, crying.
Said. Don Alvaro without cloak, with fair heart wide sleeves, and over a jacket from Majo, net on the head, boots, spurs, enters the veron and throws himself into Leonora's arms.
After several blows, the bottom door to the left was intrigued, and the Marquis of Calatrava entered enraged, wielding a sword, and followed by two Servants with light.

Large kitchen of a tavern on the ground floor. To the left is the entrance door that gives on the way; in front of a window and a cupboard with plates, etc., etc. To the right at the bottom a large burning fireplace with various pots; closer to the mouth-scenes short ladder that puts to a room, whose door is practicable. - On one side large table set up with on top a lit lamp. - The Host and the Ostessa, who do not speak, are facing to ammanir the dinner. The Alcade is sitting near the fire; a Student at the table. Some Mulattieri, among which Mastro Trabuco, who is in front of a stick. Two peasants, two peasants, the Serva and a Mulattiere dance the following. Above another table, wine, glasses, fairy tales, a bottle of aquavite. The Alcade, a sturdy, Mastro Trabuco, Mulattiere, Palas, etc.
Says and Preziosilla that comes in by jumping.
Said, and Pilgrims passing from outside.
Those above, less Master Trabuco.

A small esplanade on the slope of steep mountain. To the right is the cliffs and cliffs; in front of the façade of the church of the Madonna of the angels; on the left is the door of the convent, in the middle of which is a small window; on the one hand is the bell rope. Above there is a small protruding roof. Beyond the church high mountains with the village of Hornachuelos. The door of the church is closed, but wide, above it a semicircular window will let you see the internal light. At half-scene, a little to the left, on four steps stands a rough cross of stone corroded by time. The scene will be illuminated by a very clear moon. Leonora woman comes ascending from the right, tired, dressed as a man, with a wide sleeved pastrano, wide hat and boots.
The window of the door opens, and the light of a lantern comes out, reverberating on the face of a woman Leonora, who goes back frightened. Fra' Melitone always speaks from the inside.
Donna Leonora alone.
Donna Leonora, Father Guardian, Brother Melitone.
Leonora and Father Guardiano.

The great door of the church opens. In front of it we see the illuminated high altar. The organ plays. From the sides of the choir two long rows of friars proceed with fiery candles. Later the father Guardian precedes Leonora in a friar's dress: he leads her out of the church; the friars side around him. Leonora bows down before him, who solemnly stretching her hands over his head intuitive:
Don Alvaro in the Spanish captain's uniform of the king's grenades slowly advance from the bottom. There are internal voices on the right.
Don Alvaro returns with Don Carlo.

It is the morning. Lounge in the house of a superior officer of the Spanish army in Italy not far from Velletri. In the bottom there are two doors, the one on the left puts to one bedroom, the other is the municipality. On the left at the proscenium is a window. You hear the sound of the nearby battle. A military surgeon and some Soldiers orders from the municipality run to the window.

Don Alvaro wounded and unconscious is brought into a litter by four grenadiers. On one side is the surgeon, on the other Don Carlo covered in dust and very afflicted. A soldier lays a suitcase on a coffee table. The litter is placed almost in the middle of the scene.
Don Carlo, then the surgeon.

Military camp near Velletri. On the front left is a shop for rigattiere; on the right another, where food, drinks, fruit are sold. At the turn military tents, barracks of revendoglioli, etc., etc. It is night - the scene is deserted. A patrol carefully enters the scene, exploring the camp.
Dawn slowly. Don Alvaro comes in thinking.
Dettato and Don Carlo.
He's taking the Field Patrol to separate them.

The sun comes out. - The drum roll and the trumpet ring give the alarm signal. The scene is moving gradually. Spanish and Italian soldiers of all weapons rise from the tents, cleaning poplars, swords, uniforms, etc., etc... Boys, Militaires play dice on drums. Vivandiers who sell liquors, fruit, bread, etc. Precious from the top of a barrack predicts good wind. - Animated scene.
The attention is drawn by Trabuco revendugliolo who comes from the shop on the left with a box around the neck various objects of petty value.
Said, and peasants in quest with boys by hand.
Said, and some weeping recruits coming escorted.
Said, and Brother Melitone who, taken in the vortex of the dance, is for a moment forced to dance with the foodmen; finally, managed to stop, exclaims:

Interior of the monastery of the Madonna degli angeli. Meschino porch surrounds a corticella with orange trees, oleanders, jasmines. To the left of the spectator is the door that puts at the way; to the right another door above which is read     . Clausura.Father Guardiano walks seriously reading the breviary. - From the left come many Pezzenti of all ages and sex with rough bowls to the hand, piñates or plates.
Said and fra' Melitone, which comes from the right, covered the belly of wide white apron, and helped by other Layus, brings a large two-manic boiler, which lay in the center; the Layus starts again.
Father Guardian and Brother Melitone.
Br. Melitone and Fr. Carlo, who is wrapped in a great cloak, enters frankly.
Don Carlo, then Don Alvaro in a monk's dress.

Valley among inaccessible rocks, crossed by a stream. On the left of the viewer is a cave with practicable door, and on a bell that can be played from the inside. It is the sunset. The scene is slowly darkened; the moon appears gorgeous. Donna Leonora pale, disfigured, comes out of the very agitated cave.
You hear inside the scene a cozzar of swords.
Said and Leonora who shows up on the door.
Leonora wounded enters sustained by the Guardian, and said.
Act IV, scenes VII-IX, version of 1862.
